title: Refuse reuse of an exchange operation id across bindings of one Git directory
outcome: Refuse reuse of an exchange operation id across bindings of one Git directory
acceptance: prepare refuses, before any write, an operation id already Prepared under any binding whose Git directory is the same directory (same_directory)
A test prepares an outgoing operation under a binding, supersedes it, re-prepares the same operation under the successor and asserts the refusal with no new event or artifact
